site.name: FWD Marketplace
site.description: Freelance project marketplace for junior graduates of Fundación Forward Costa Rica.

hero.title: Get your first professional project
hero.description: Real companies post short-term projects for junior talent from Fundación Forward Costa Rica. Build experience, strengthen your portfolio, and start your professional career.

how_it_works.title: Three steps to boost your career
how_it_works.step1_desc: Show your stack, availability, and experience so companies can get to know you.
how_it_works.step2_desc: Explore opportunities aligned with your profile and filter by technology, modality, and duration.
how_it_works.step3_desc: Connect with real companies, develop projects, and gain professional experience.

cta.title: Your next opportunity starts today
cta.description: Join the marketplace created to boost emerging tech talent.

role.title: How will you use FWD?
role.description: Choose the profile that best describes you.
role.junior_description: Looking for real projects to grow and gain experience.
role.empresa_description: I want to publish projects and work with FWD talent.
role.emprendedor_description: Looking for technical support to grow my project.

step1.title: What's your name?
step1.description: We use your name to personalize your experience.
step1.label: Full name

step2.title: What's your specialization?
step2.description: Choose the one that best describes your current profile.

step3.title: How do you prefer to work?
step3.description: You can choose more than one.

step4.title: When can you start?
step4.description: This is shown on your public profile.

step5.title: What technologies do you know?
step5.description: Select all that apply. You can edit this later.

step6.title: Where can we see your work?
step6.description: All fields are optional. You can add them later from your profile.

step7.title: Tell us a bit about yourself.
step7.description: A short description that companies will see on your profile.
step7.label: Description
step7.placeholder: E.g.: Frontend developer focused on React and interface design. FWD 2025 graduate, passionate about clean code and products with real impact.

done.title: Your profile is ready.
done.description: Now find your first project and start building your career.

step1.title: What's your company's name?
step1.description: Use the commercial or legal name.
step1.label: Company name

step2.title: What sector does it operate in?
step2.description: You can choose more than one.

step3.title: What does your company do?
step3.description: This description appears on your public profile and in the projects you publish.
step3.label: Company description
step3.placeholder: E.g.: We are a software company focused on logistics solutions for the retail sector in Central America.

step4.title: We need to verify your company.
step4.description: This information is confidential and only used to validate your account.

step5.title: What type of projects do you want to publish?
step5.description: This helps us show you the most suitable talent.

step6.title: Add your company logo.
step6.description: Optional. JPG or PNG, maximum 5 MB. You can upload it later from your profile.

done.title: Your company is registered.
done.description: An FWD admin will review your account in the next 24 hours. We'll notify you when you're ready to publish projects.

step1.title: What's your startup called?
step1.description: Use the name your audience knows it by.
step1.label: Startup name

step2.title: What stage is it at?
step2.description: This helps us connect you with the most suitable talent.
step2.mvp_description: I have a prototype or initial version
step2.validating_description: I have users and want to grow
step2.scaling_description: I want to take the product to the next level

step3.title: What type of technical support are you looking for?
step3.description: You can choose more than one.

step4.title: What's your budget range?
step4.description: This is a guide — you can adjust it when publishing your project.

step5.title: Tell us about your project.
step5.description: A description that talent will see before applying. Optional — you can complete it later.
step5.label: Project description
step5.placeholder: E.g.: We're building an app to connect local producers with consumers. We need a dev to help with the frontend in React and integration with our API.

done.title: Your profile is ready.
done.description: You can start exploring available talent and publish your first project.

login.title: Welcome back
login.description: Sign in with the account you used to register.
